Before we launch

A few things worth knowing.

What happens at the daily reveal?

The intended service keeps the published Picturepurdle unchanged for 24 hours. At the scheduled reveal it incorporates new approved, paid photos and saves the new edition. With no new approved photos, the artwork stays unchanged. This preview’s clock is live, but its two sample editions are fixed; no automatic publication happens.

Can I revisit an old edition or remove a photo?

The intended timeline starts at launch, not before. Photo IDs would connect to their locations in each saved version. Removal requests would need to cover current and archived versions; outside copies cannot be recalled. These processes still need to be implemented.

What photos are allowed?

Your own photo, people you have permission to share, loved ones being remembered, and pets are welcome in the concept. We may decline or remove inappropriate submissions, including pornography, sexualized minors, graphic violence, hate or unlawful material. AI screening would flag uncertain cases for review; it is not connected here.

Which features work in this preview?

The sample mosaic zoom, daily comparison, countdown, photo finder, local photo selection, order calculator, sample bank and share links work as a demonstration. The displayed portraits repeat a small fictional set. Real payments, accounts, public uploads, charitable transfers, automated moderation and scheduled artwork generation are not active.
